registry_text_sample: Promotion requires BOTH (per active MODEL_V2_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL_V2, official_validation.promotion_requirement): (A) mean three-seed official VALIDATION AUPRC > 0.646, AND (B) the paired patient-cluster-bootstrap delta-AUPRC-vs-MODEL_V1 lower-95%-CI bound > 0, for the required release-seed/three-seed comparisons; plus three-seed confirmation and no material AUROC regression (carried forward from V1). The release checkpoint is always seed 20260927, fixed regardless of score -- no seed may be selected because it scores highest after VALIDATION.
